charts.caption: Peak relative divergence between engine and extraction, per observable and condition. The inflammation states (tissue integrity, blood pathogen) agree to well under 0.1% in both arms; the hemodynamic states carry all the divergence — small but nonzero at mild (the engine's fluctuation) and large at severe (the different decompensation mechanism and ~11 h lag).

charts.title: 03_functional_difference_matrix
charts.caption: Map of BioGears functionality to its fate in the extraction and to the run-for-run result. The inflammation core is translated faithfully (identical output); the cardiovascular control and fluid systems are simplified; and a cluster of vasomotor/fluid/metabolic subsystems (nitric oxide, fever vasodilation, renal/urine, lactate, intracellular water, respiration, nutrition) is omitted or inert — exactly the pathways that would couple into SVR, CO and volume, which is where every divergence lands.

charts.title: Each divergence mapped to an omitted or simplified BioGears subsystem
charts.caption: Map of BioGears functionality to its fate in the extraction and to the run-for-run result. The inflammation core is translated faithfully (identical output); the cardiovascular control and fluid systems are simplified; and a cluster of vasomotor/fluid/metabolic subsystems (nitric oxide, fever vasodilation, renal/urine, lactate, intracellular water, respiration, nutrition) is omitted or inert — exactly the pathways that would couple into SVR, CO and volume, which is where every divergence lands.
